rows.grounds: finite verb expressing the consequence enacted by the subject
direct object denoting the spiritual family or lineage affected
points to the person who improperly causes initiation after mere seeing or hearing
describes the state of the agents performing the destruction
compound subject naming the collective agents; yoginī+gaṇa

items.question: What consequence befalls the lineage of one who improperly confers kula initiation?
premises: Improper conferral of kula initiation provokes a powerful response.
The enraged groups of yoginīs act as agents of retribution.
The target of this retribution is the offender's lineage.
items.inference: Therefore, the enraged groups of yoginīs destroy the lineage of the one who improperly confers kula initiation.
uncertainties: Whether kulaṃ refers specifically to the ritual lineage, family line, or spiritual community is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The enraged groups of yoginīs destroy the lineage of that person.
